title: HUMORCHAIN: Theory-Guided Multi-Stage Reasoning for Interpretable Multimodal Humor Generation

live_model.evidence: "we use GPT-5-2025-08-07 as the backbone reasoning model in our experiments" (Sec 4); Table 3: "I vs A 300 0.695 0.305" (Total pairwise comparisons, Win Rate HUMORCHAIN vs. zero-shot baseline).

prompt.location: Sec 3/4 describe theory-guided, CoT-fused and few-shot prompt variants; annotator instructions in Appendix H, dataset config in Appendix F
prompt.note: No single verbatim generation-prompt template was located in the excerpted text.

claim.metric: Win Rate (human pairwise preference), HUMORCHAIN vs. zero-shot baseline (I vs A)

data.source: Meme-Image-No-Text (internal), plus public Oogiri-GO and OxfordTVG-HIC for cross-model comparisons

notes: GPT-5 also drives a LoRA-fine-tuned discriminator loop (5-retry threshold 0.66), so the full HUMORCHAIN pipeline needs more than a bare prompt to reproduce exactly, but the underlying backbone captions are GPT-5-2025-08-07 outputs judged by human annotators. Soft gaps: no verbatim generation prompt located, and the internal dataset's public status is unclear.
